definitions.ask: Should bob-ledger-tools also undo any scroll of Obsidian's never-scrolling workspace containers and log the cause?
definitions.why: The white-screen trigger didn't reproduce on Linux; these containers never legitimately scroll.

choices.label: Add the guard; the white screen can't stick whatever the trigger, and each catch logs its cause.
Fix only the confirmed card, click, and focus defects; a recurrence needs fresh debugging.
